title: AWS launches European Sovereign Cloud, creating a new parent company for its sovereign cloud that will be locally controlled in the EU and run by EU citizens (Arjun Kharpal/CNBC)
summary: Arjun Kharpal / CNBC: AWS launches European Sovereign Cloud, creating a new parent company for its sovereign cloud that will be locally controlled in the EU and run by EU citizens — Amazon launched its “sovereign cloud” offering in Europe on Thursday in a move designed to keep it among the leading players …
